rootCause: forecast_rows selects growth with row.get("growth_override") or baseline_growth. Because Python treats numeric 0 and an empty string as falsy, both values currently fall back to the baseline; this contradicts test_explicit_zero_override_is_preserved, while test_blank_override_uses_baseline confirms that only a blank override should do so.
intendedChange: Keep the public forecast_rows(rows, baseline_growth) API. Read growth_override explicitly, use baseline_growth only when the override is blank (the fixture supplies ""), otherwise convert the override with float and use it. Let conversion failures raise ValueError augmented with the row's row_id so test_invalid_override_names_the_row can identify "west".
risks: Missing growth_override is currently treated like a blank override by row.get(... ) or baseline_growth; the requested fixture only specifies blank text, so the repair should preserve that practical fallback if possible.
The error path must retain the original conversion failure as context while reliably including row_id in the ValueError message.
Revenue and baseline_growth are also converted with float in the existing implementation; changing those conversions would expand the requested scope.
